title: Motorcycles & Powersports Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rever:ride
| eval day_type=if(in(strftime(_time,"%u"),"6","7"),"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by day_type
description: Separates motorcycles activity between weekdays and weekends when duration is present.
value: Weekend/weekday splits quickly show whether a life domain is work-driven, leisure-driven, or bleeding into the wrong days.
implementation: Populate optional `duration_min` on `rever:ride` events if available; the search still works on counts alone when duration is missing.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart of weekday vs weekend event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It works out whether your motorcycles activity mostly happens on weekdays or weekends so you can see if the habit fits the life you actually live.
